title: Headless build in Brett's AmberX-AXF repo (this worktree, branch claude/orch-rename).
asked: Headless build in Brett's AmberX-AXF repo (this worktree, branch claude/orch-rename). Read CLAUDE.md and _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md. Opus, one session. Brett: in the Build orchestrator plugin (console -> Builds -> Build orchestrator, apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator) he can drag/rearrange builds and steps but CANNOT RENAME them. Add rename: 1. Rename a build, a step, and a build profile: double-tap/double-click the name, or right-click (long-press on phone) -> Rename, or the row menu. Inline edit, Enter/blur saves, Esc cancels, empty name refused. 2. Only the display title changes; the id stays the same so links, PRs, THREADS rows, tracker, Pending builds and history don't break. Every place that shows the build/step name (orchestrator, Build manager banner, Pending builds, Plan Studio, AmberX build views) shows the new title. 3. Server: a rename endpoint in the orchestrator server that writes the title into the right _claude/builds/profiles/<profile>/orchestrator.json (and the registry for profiles), logs old -> new with time. 4. Framework controls + theme/scale tokens only (asset-conformant). Add tests (rename build/step/profile, id unchanged, empty refused). Run the full local test block from .github/workflows/android.yml + theme/controls/lifecycle checks; all green. 5. Commit; git fetch origin && git merge origin/main; retest; git push origin HEAD:main, retry until it lands. Short detailed report at _claude/builds/reports/orch-rename.md.
